about: Aphex Twin - Ptolemy (Selected Ambient Works 85-92), from the official album master's stems at a4 449 and 117.3 BPM. Drums: the 909-class song kit; from 64 s kick, snare and hats are programmed on the record's grid (griddrums, 117.305 BPM, T0 1.769 s), the earlier transcribed parts kept before it; kick tuned G#1 to the stem's 52.7 Hz peak. Bass: the stem-derived 303-style line as notes. Tonal carrier: the bright arpeggio guide. The wide chord pad of the vocals stem (112-352 s) transcribed per second as detuned saws with a slow swell. Master: section levels, band width, section EQ and contour rides fitted to the record.

pto-kit.about: Ptolemy song-local captured909-class synth palette; not confirmed original hardware. Independent rawkit into captured shared drum FX bus; no shared default changes.

pto-bass.about: 303-style acid bass: saw into a resonant low-pass with a snappy envelope; velocity is accent (louder, brighter, more squelch); overlapping notes slide (mono legato).

pto-tonal.about: Bright plucked synth for arpeggios — saw and square through a snappy filter envelope, dotted-eighth ping-pong delay.

pto-voice-pad.about: Ptolemy r16: the wide sustained chord pad of the vocals stem (112-352 s), transcribed per second; detuned saws, slow swell, chorus and hall. Not a sampled choir.
